description_excerpt: Job Description • Support or perform EHS sampling as instructed by Technical Supervisor/Manager including Field, Monitoring and Marine services. • Monitor daily performance and investigate any problems in terms of manpower planning and quality of sampling. • Assist in the correct execution of projects • Schedule manpower for project execution • Follow up with laboratories to receive results on time • Prepare draft report • Frequently obtain, update, and maintain standard operating procedures • Provide explanations of technical or operational issues to clients as needed • Coordinate/liaise…
